redFirst.basis: `node --test tests/issues.test.mjs` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1, but its output carries no test tally this command reads, so an assertion failure cannot be told from a crash - no test is known to have been collected: AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: Expected values to be strictly equal:; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, OLDPWD, PWD; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: .venv - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own .venv and is not watched; no .npmrc to carry or drop

outcome.technical: Added scripts/issues.mjs (import-audit, merge, path; exports importAudit, mergeIssues, sortIssues, repoSlug, outputDir; ESM, zero deps). import-audit maps bugs[] and phases[].review.findings[] incl. legacy strings (id <phaseId>-<zero-based index>, leading [sev] tag before or after the path) to source 'audit' issues with id audit-<id> and track; anchors to the node owning the file via lib/glob.mjs (longest literal glob prefix wins, then deeper level, then id; fallback exact evidence path), skips closed/fixed/resolved, line-level (keyword heuristic), and unanchored/no-path entries, printing 'imported N, skipped-fixed N, skipped-unanchored N, skipped-line-level N'. Re-import replaces audit-source issues of --existing and keeps others; output sorted by sev then id, byte-identical on re-run. merge replaces existing issues on listed anchor ids (all when no --anchors), refuses duplicate ids. path prints <home>/.claude/archmap/<slug>/ (slug of git toplevel or project dir name). --out inside the project's git working tree is refused with exit 2 before anything is created (non-git project: no refusal); result is validated with validate(model,{issues}) and refused with exit 1 if invalid (dangling anchors). Fixtures tests/fixtures/issues/{model.json,audit-plan.json}; tests/issues.test.mjs cases i1-i9. Observed: node --test tests/issues.test.mjs 9/9 pass; first run before the script existed failed (module not found); full node --test 208/208 pass. Deviations/judgement: (a) merge also requires --model (needed for validate()); (b) evidence with a path but no lines files lines '1' because the task says import reads only the plan file (the catalogue's 'open the file and cite a line' is not done); (c) impact/fix are non-fabricated placeholders ('Tracked by the audit as <sev> severity; see the audit entry X.' / resolution or 'See the audit entry X.'), security summary = title only with full text in detail; (d) only node anchors are chosen, never edge/entity. Dependants: docs/design.md and skills/architecture-map/SKILL.md name issues.mjs by basename only - still correct (design lists issues.mjs in the scripts tree; SKILL.md output-location slug rule is implemented as written); the merge command line in design lacks --model, which this adds. tests/fixtures/issues dependants (schema, render, validate, viewer, commands tests etc.) match by basename only; no existing file under that dir was changed, so they are unaffected. No plan-gate refusals encountered.
outcome.descriptive: scripts/issues.mjs now imports open audit findings as anchored overlay issues, merges reviewer output by anchor, and writes the overlay only outside the repo after validation.
